2410.12361.title: Proactive Agent: Shifting LLM Agents from Reactive Responses to Active Assistance
2410.12361.summary: Predicts user tasks from desktop events and studies proactive assistance without explicit instructions.
2410.12361.boundary: A research implementation and benchmark, not a mature resident-assistant product.
2410.12361.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2505.14668.title: ContextAgent: Context-Aware Proactive LLM Agents with Open-World Sensory Perceptions
2505.14668.summary: Uses sensory context from wearable devices and historical user profiles to predict when to provide a service and invoke tools.
2505.14668.boundary: Sensing and service-prediction evaluations cannot be equated with full autonomous desktop control.

2602.04482.title: ProAgentBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Proactive Assistance with Real-World Data
2602.04482.summary: Evaluates the timing and content of proactive assistance using real workflow logs.
2602.04482.boundary: Focused on judging proactive assistance; not a system-level reliability test.
2602.04482.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2603.08013.title: PIRA-Bench: A Transition from Reactive GUI Agents to GUI-based Proactive Intent Recommendation Agents
2603.08013.summary: Recommends likely intents from continuous GUI screenshots and user context.
2603.08013.boundary: Intent recommendation and actually completing the recommended task must be evaluated separately.
2603.08013.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2605.14678.title: π-Bench: Evaluating Proactive Personal Assistant Agents in Long-Horizon Workflows
2605.14678.summary: Evaluates hidden-need recognition and proactive assistance across long multi-turn workflows.
2605.14678.boundary: Task completion rate and proactivity are different metrics.
2605.14678.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2604.08000.title: PASK: Toward Intent-Aware Proactive Agents with Long-Term Memory
2604.08000.summary: Combines long-term memory, live context and latency constraints to detect latent needs and choose between assisting and staying silent.
2604.08000.boundary: Author-labelled technical report; research in progress.
2604.08000.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2610.08699.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
2610.08699.summary: Presents the software architecture, memory design and continuous-interaction design of a cross-device personal agent.
2610.08699.boundary: A systems paper; the authors' priority claims are not treated as verified fact.
2610.08699.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2610.22671.title: MemoProAgent: Toward Memory-Driven Proactive Assistance
2610.22671.summary: Studies retrieving intervention evidence from long-term personal memory so that memory participates in the decision of whether to speak up.
2610.22671.boundary: The latest version's title is MemoProAgent; the earlier name ProPerAgent is not listed separately.
2610.22671.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2606.16748.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
2606.16748.summary: Evaluates computer-use assistants in digital environments holding personal data and logged-in state.
2606.16748.boundary: A personalized-execution evaluation; it cannot replace intervention-timing evaluation.
2606.16748.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2609.37267.title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
2609.37267.summary: Discusses the technical layers and user costs of proactive agents and introduces Proactivity-Gym.
2609.37267.boundary: A conceptual framework and evaluation environment, not a product-quality leaderboard.
2609.37267.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2603.19466.title: ProactiveBench: Benchmarking Proactiveness in Multimodal Large Language Models
2603.19466.summary: Evaluates whether multimodal models proactively gather extra information to complete visual tasks.
2603.19466.boundary: Different from the identically named benchmark used by ProactiveAgent; the paper page currently notes ECCV 2026.

2603.23064.title: Mind Your HEARTBEAT! Claw Background Execution Inherently Enables Silent Memory Pollution
2603.23064.summary: Studies silent memory pollution caused by background heartbeat runs touching untrusted content.
2603.23064.boundary: The evaluation is version-bounded; pre-fix conclusions must not be applied to all current versions.
2603.23064.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2605.13471.title: Sleeper Channels and Provenance Gates: Persistent Prompt Injection in Always-on Autonomous AI Agents
2605.13471.summary: Analyzes indirect prompt-injection paths that persist across memory, skills, scheduling and the file system.
2605.13471.boundary: An architecture and threat study, not a general security rating across current products.
2605.13471.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2404.07972.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
2404.07972.summary: Provides an open-ended task-execution benchmark in real computer environments.
2404.07972.boundary: Primarily measures execution capability; it does not show that agents discover tasks on their own.
2404.07972.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2304.03442.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
2304.03442.summary: Studies building simulated agents that live and interact autonomously through memory, reflection and planning.
2304.03442.boundary: Foundational simulated-world research, not a personal computer assistant.
2304.03442.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2604.08455.title: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation
2604.08455.summary: Evaluates mobile agents on interactively eliciting preferences, intervening proactively, asking for consent, or staying silent.
2604.08455.boundary: Mobile GUI and personal-preference scenarios; desktop workflows need separate testing.
2604.08455.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified

2604.00842.title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
2604.00842.summary: Studies proactive assistants in a simulated environment with stateful apps and active users.
2604.00842.boundary: Simulated-user results cannot directly replace evaluation with real long-term users.
2604.00842.publication_note: arXiv; conference status not independently verified
